title: Disentangling Depression from Cognitive Decline in Elderly Speech Using Concurrent Clinical Assessments
abstract: arXiv:2610.26890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detecting depression from speech in elderly patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is complicated by overlapping acoustic effects of cognitive decline. Without disentangling these, classifiers risk learning cognitive rather than depression-specific patterns. We present a Korean elderly speech corpus of 89 MCI speakers collected over three years with concurrent depression (SGDS) and cognitive (MMSE) assessments. Both linear mixed-effects models and partial correlations identify the same pattern: of seven feature groups, only formant features are associated with depression after controlling for cognitive function, while widely used F0 features carry no signal. The F1+F2 subset achieves UAR 0.760 with just 12 features, outperforming both the full eGeMAPS baseline and self-supervised representations. translated_title: 利用同步临床评估从老年人语音中解耦抑郁与认知衰退
translated_abstract: 从轻度认知障碍（MCI）老年患者的语音中检测抑郁症，会因认知衰退产生的重叠声学效应而变得复杂。若不将这些效应解耦，分类器可能学习到的是认知相关的模式，而非抑郁特异性的模式。我们提出了一个韩国老年人语音语料库，包含89名MCI说话者，历时三年收集，并同时进行抑郁（SGDS）和认知（MMSE）评估。线性混合效应模型和偏相关分析均识别出相同的模式：在七个特征组中，只有共振峰特征在控制认知功能后与抑郁相关，而广泛使用的F0（基频）特征不携带任何信号。仅使用12个特征的F1+F2子集实现了0.760的UAR（非加权平均召回率），优于完整的eGeMAPS基线和自监督表示。这些发现表明，同步临床评估能够在该人群中识别出可解释的、抑郁特异性的声学标记。
tldr: 该研究利用历时三年收集、带有同步抑郁与认知评估的韩国MCI老年人语音语料库，发现控制认知功能后仅共振峰特征与抑郁相关，仅12个特征的F1+F2子集即达到UAR 0.760，超越完整eGeMAPS基线和自监督表示。
en_tdlr: Using a three-year Korean elderly MCI speech corpus with concurrent depression and cognitive assessments, this study shows that only formant features remain associated with depression after controlling for cognitive function, with a 12-feature F1+F2 subset achieving UAR 0.760, outperforming both the full eGeMAPS baseline and self-supervised representations.
